correctness.rationale: For fixed \(n\) and \(\gamma\), the exact band-edge equations reduce the problem to one parity-matched Weber-Hermite function. The Kummer large-argument expansion and the simple zero of \(1/\Gamma(A)\) at a non-positive integer give the exact Dirichlet Newton quotient \(C_n a^{2n+1}e^{-a^2}(1+O(a^{-2}))\), with \(C_n=2^{n+2}/(\sqrt\pi\,n!)\) in both parities. The decaying and growing logarithmic derivatives are respectively \(-a+n/a+O(a^{-3})\) and \(a-(n+1)/a+O(a^{-3})\), yielding the Robin factor \(-1+2\gamma/a+O(a^{-2})\). Analyticity and the exponentially small root displacement control the Taylor remainder. The two nearby roots are the unique edges converging to \(2n\).

value.rationale: The anchor explicitly identifies low-band asymptotics and the fixed-\(\gamma\), large-\(a\) regime as open directions. The theorem resolves that regime at every fixed oscillator level with an exact prefactor and reveals a non-obvious separation of scales: fixed \(\gamma\) does not affect the leading tunnelling constant and enters only through the relative correction \(-\gamma/a\). This is a natural tight-binding invariant of the model rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
